_comment: SQL 검증 픽스처(3단계 설계 10.4, M27, M27 검토 보강). 표는 sales(id, region, amount, card 숨김, sold_on), customers(id, name, email 숨김), secret(숨긴 표)다. expect가 ok면 통과하고 sql_executed에 contains가 들어 있어야 한다. 아니면 그 거부 코드다.

allowed.sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT * FROM sales
SELECT s.* FROM sales AS s WHERE s.amount > 10
WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', sold_on) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales GROUP BY 1) SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY month
SELECT region, amount, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY amount DESC) AS r FROM sales
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sales AS s JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = s.id GROUP BY c.name
SELECT strftime(sold_on, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY ym
SELECT CASE WHEN amount >= 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END AS size, COUNT(*) FROM sales GROUP BY 1
SELECT region FROM sales UNION SELECT name FROM customers
allowed.contains: UNION SELECT name FROM customers LIMIT 201

allowed.sql: SELECT region FROM sales FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COALESCE(region, '없음') AS region, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg FROM sales GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
SELECT 1 /* 주석 */ ; -- 끝 주석
SELECT * EXCLUDE (amount) FROM sales
allowed.contains: sales.region AS region, sales.sold_on AS sold_on

allowed.sql: SELECT quantile_cont(amount, 0.5) AS median_amount FROM sales
SELECT x FROM generate_series(1, 3) AS t(x)
SELECT strftime('%Y', sold_on) AS y, total(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY y
SELECT name, iif(id > 1, '기존', '신규') AS kind FROM customers
WITH RECURSIVE n(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM n WHERE x < 5) SELECT x FROM n
SELECT j.value FROM customers, json_each('[1,2]') AS j
SELECT * FROM main.sales WHERE region LIKE '서%' LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1
(SELECT region FROM sales ORDER BY region) LIMIT 5

rejected.sql: WITH x AS (INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1) RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM x
SELECT q.card FROM (SELECT * FROM sales) AS q
SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE 1 IN (WITH sqlite_master AS (SELECT 1 AS a) SELECT a FROM sqlite_master)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM secret WHERE 1 IN (WITH secret AS (SELECT 1 AS a) SELECT a FROM secret)
WITH sales AS (SELECT 1 AS a) SELECT a FROM sales
SELECT * FROM customers c JOIN (SELECT 'k@example.com' AS email) g USING (email)
SELECT c.* FROM customers c JOIN (SELECT 'k@example.com' AS email) g USING (email)
SELECT rowid, * FROM customers JOIN (SELECT 'k@example.com' AS email) g USING (email)
SELECT * FROM customers JOIN (SELECT 'k@example.com' AS email) g USING (email), json_each('[1]')
SELECT name FROM customers NATURAL JOIN (SELECT 'k@example.com' AS email) g
SELECT * FROM (PIVOT sales ON region USING sum(amount))
